narrativeVibe: Everyday city life, warm and grounded — work and rent, friendships and ambitions, small moments that matter.
scenario: Life in the city: a cramped apartment, a job that pays the bills (mostly), friends who feel like family, and a head full of plans. Rent is due, the fridge is empty, and something has to change — what happens next is up to you.
start: Monday morning. Your alarm loses to the snooze button, the coffee machine gurgles its last for the week, and your phone is already buzzing — your best friend landed you a lead on a better job across town, interview tomorrow. The city hums outside your window. {{user}}, what do you do?
imageStyleTags: (masterpiece:1.2), cinematic, photorealistic, photography, urban realism, natural light, high detail
imageNegativeTags: low quality, fused digits, bad anatomy, watermark, text

defs.label: Social
defs.hint: Conversation and connections — talking, persuading, making friends
defs.rules: Conversation, persuasion and networking. Used to talk your way into (or out of) things, win people over, read a room and build relationships.

defs.label: Fitness
defs.rules: Physical conditioning. Used for strength, stamina and athletic effort — running, lifting, sports, fighting, hiking and staying healthy.

defs.label: Intellect
defs.hint: Knowledge and logic — learning, analysis, problem-solving
defs.rules: Learning, memory and analytical thinking. Used to study, reason through problems, pick up new subjects quickly and connect the dots.

defs.label: Handy
defs.hint: Practical skills — fixing, building, repairs, DIY
defs.rules: Practical, hands-on skill. Used to fix, build and maintain things around the home and on the go — plumbing, wiring, assembly, small repairs and improvisation with everyday tools.

defs.label: Creativity
defs.hint: Creative expression — art, writing, cooking, improvisation
defs.rules: Creative expression. Used for art, writing, music, cooking, design and thinking up original ideas or clever improvisations on the spot.

defs.label: Insight
defs.hint: Reading people and situations — empathy, intuition
defs.rules: Empathy and intuition. Used to read moods and intentions, tell when someone is lying or hurting, and understand what a situation really needs.

defs.label: Street Smarts
defs.hint: Everyday savvy — navigating the city, finding things, blending in
defs.rules: Everyday savvy. Used to navigate the city, find the right people or places, blend into a crowd, haggle and survive day-to-day urban life.

defs.label: Tech
defs.hint: Digital fluency — devices, apps, computers, online life
defs.rules: Comfort and skill with modern technology. Used for phones, computers, apps, settings, online research, social media and troubleshooting devices.

trackers.label: Day Name
trackers.effects: The current day of the week.
trackers.rules: Use exactly one of: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday or Sunday. Advance to the next weekday whenever a full day passes in the story.

trackers.label: Time
trackers.rules: Use exactly one of: Morning, Afternoon, Evening or Night. Advance as the story's hours pass; roughly one step per few hours of in-game time.

trackers.effects: Where the hero currently is — neighborhood, building or landmark.
trackers.rules: Keep it short and specific, e.g. "Downtown — police precinct", "Riverside, apartment 4B". Update whenever the scene moves.

trackers.label: Lvl
trackers.effects: The hero's level. A higher level means a more seasoned and capable person.
trackers.rules: Rises when the hero earns enough exp.

trackers.label: Exp
trackers.effects: Experience points toward the next level.
trackers.rules: Award for solving problems and breakthroughs. When exp reaches 100, the hero levels up and exp resets to 0.

trackers.label: Cash
trackers.rules: Increase from paychecks, jobs and sales; decrease from purchases, fees and payments.

trackers.label: Stamina
trackers.effects: Physical energy for exertion — running, fighting, long days. Empty stamina means exhaustion.
trackers.rules: Decrease during hard physical effort; recover with rest and food.

npcTrackers.label: Trust
npcTrackers.effects: How much this character trusts the hero; high trust unlocks secrets and aid, low trust risks betrayal.
npcTrackers.rules: Moves when the hero keeps or breaks promises.

npcTrackers.label: Mood
npcTrackers.effects: Current emotional state; a hostile mood closes dialogue options while a warm one opens them.
npcTrackers.rules: Shifts with how the hero treats them.
